name: Givre - Station alpine
coordinateSystem: right-handed Y-up; already converted from Blender (X,Z,-Y); north = -Z, east = +X

sun.three: DirectionalLight : position = target + directionToSun * 200, intensity ~ blenderStrength en lumieres physiques (r155+), a ajuster a l'oeil

ambient.three: HemisphereLight(skyColor, groundColor) ; intensity ~ PI x blenderStrength en lumieres physiques

skyBackground.mapping: fac = clamp((dir.y + 0.02) / 0.82, 0, 1) ; dir = direction de vue normalisee (Y haut)

lighting.colorManagement: Sortie sRGB sans tone mapping (Blender : Standard) pour garder les aplats du concept
lighting.interiors: Dans Blender : panneaux emissifs + lumieres de zone (non exportees). En jeu : l'ambiance hemisphere suffit, ajouter quelques PointLight si besoin.
